title: Meeting lab partner Barry; earlier teams were already at ease with the craft

tellings.quote: these guys had reached a point where it was nonchalant.

plain: Bob Lazar told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about his time in 1988 and 1989 at S-4, a secret site in the Nevada desert where he says he worked on recovered alien craft. He says he was paired with a lab partner named Barry, and that the teams who had been there before him had reached the point where working with the craft was nonchalant. If true, it would mean the government had been studying such craft long enough for it to feel routine.
